title: Spire Legacy — Three Classes & Permanent Progression
description:
[b]Every climb ends. Your bloodline grows.[/b]

Play The Heir, a custom Slay the Spire 2 character with three inherited classes and a permanent Family Manor. Choose a Knight, Mage, or Ranger heir, adapt to unusual traits, and spend earned crowns rebuilding your family's home. After each climb, choose from three new heirs and carry your legacy into the next run.

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/9933452405272609969/7DA588CC5B74C4DE4D2C4D118B5502B064CDA01E/[/img]

[b]Different heirs. The same family manor.[/b] Traits belong to each heir; purchased manor upgrades stay with the family. Save crowns over multiple climbs to invest in future heirs.

[h2]Three ways to climb[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Knight — counterattack.[/b] Play a Skill to prime your next Attack for +2 damage on every hit.
[*][b]Mage — build a burst.[/b] Skills build up to two Arcane Charges, adding damage to every hit of your next Attack.
[*][b]Ranger — keep the chain going.[/b] Every third Attack in a turn draws a card and applies Vulnerable to its target.
[/list]
Each class has its own starters, specialties, and reward pool, alongside shared family cards.

[h2]Build a family across runs[/h2]
[list]
[*]61 inherited traits change your heir's strengths, limitations, appearance, and basic cards.
[*]Spend earned crowns on six permanent manor upgrades, from extra health to an additional card drawn each turn.
[*]Name your family, choose its banner, and select your next heir after each climb.
[/list]

[h2]What's included[/h2]
[list]
[*]82 reward cards per class on regular, or 85 on public-beta, plus three basics per class. Each reward pool includes 34 shared family cards.
[*]360 illustrated historical card definitions retained for saved-card compatibility; active rewards use the class pools above.
[*]Seven exclusive relic drops, three Heir potions, and six class Ancient cards.
[*]48 first/return conversations across eight Ancients, plus class-specific Architect ending dialogue.
[*]Custom portraits, sprites, trait icons, class badges, effects, and sounds.
[*]Solo and co-op, with independent heirs and local family progression.
[/list]

[h2]Start playing[/h2]
Subscribe to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3737335127]BaseLib[/url] and this mod. Enable both in the game's mod list, restart if requested, and select [b]The Heir[/b]. Open [b]Family Manor & Heir Lab[/b] from character selection to choose your family and heir.

[h2]Feedback and support[/h2]
Tell me which class and build you tried, what felt fun, and what needs work. Report problems in the comments or on [url=https://github.com/CapeKid/SpireLegacy/issues]GitHub[/url], including your game branch, game/mod versions, and heir traits.

[url=https://github.com/CapeKid/SpireLegacy/blob/main/docs/sts2-port.md]Installation and co-op guides[/url] | [url=https://github.com/CapeKid/SpireLegacy]Source code[/url]

[b]Credits[/b]
Created by CapeKid. Original mod code and artwork: MIT, CapeKid. Mod artwork is included; no content extraction or game-derived assets are distributed. Slay the Spire 2 belongs to Mega Crit.
